import json,hashlib,pathlib
r=json.load(open('eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json'))

print('snapshot mismatches',bad,'count',len(r['artifact_snapshot']['artifacts']))
cur=sorted(str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('system-spec').iterdir() if p.is_file())
print('files not in snapshot',[c for c in cur if c not in r['artifact_snapshot']['artifacts']])
s=json.load(open('system-spec/spec-state.json'))
print('targets',s['targets'])
D4=[d for d in s['decisions'] if d.get('id')=='D4'][0]
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in D4.items() if k!='options'},ensure_ascii=False)[:1800])
fr=json.load(open('system-spec/fetched-references.json'))
print([x['target_id'] for x in fr['references']])
PY
